gap.definition:
n. a conspicuous disparity or difference as between two figures
n. a narrow opening
n. a difference (especially an unfortunate difference) between two opinions or two views or two situations
v. make an opening or gap in
gap.translation:
n. 缝隙, 缺口, 间断, 间距, 通用汇编程序
vt. 打开缺口, 造成缝隙
vi. 豁开
[计] 通用汇编程序, 图形应用程序, 间距

gap depth.translation:
系列间距
[计] 系列间距

gap junction.translation: 缝管隙连接, 缝隙连接

gap width.translation:
分类间距
[计] 分类间距

gap year.translation: n. 空档年, 间隔年（指中学毕业生在上大学前去旅游, 做义工或者做临时工的一段时间）

gap-toothed.translation: a. 牙齿不齐全的, 牙齿间隙大的

gape.definition:
n. an expression of openmouthed astonishment
n. a stare of amazement (usually with the mouth open)
v. be wide open
gape.translation:
n. 裂口, 张嘴, 打哈欠
vi. 裂开, 张嘴, 打哈欠

gape at.translation: 目瞪口呆地看着,吃惊地看

gaped.translation: v. 目瞪口呆地凝视( gape的过去式和过去分词 ); 张开, 张大

gapemouthed.translation: a. 张大嘴的,目瞪口呆的

gaper.definition:
n. One who gapes.
n. A European fish. See 4th Comber.
n. A large edible clam (Schizothaerus Nuttalli), of the Pacific
   coast; -- called also gaper clam.
n. An East Indian bird of the genus Cymbirhynchus, related to
   the broadbills.
gaper.translation: n. 打呵欠的人, 目瞪口呆的人

gapes.definition:
n an expression of openmouthed astonishment
n a stare of amazement (usually with the mouth open)
v look with amazement; look stupidly
v be wide open
v make an opening or gap in

gapeseed.translation: n. 注目, 引人注目的事物

gapesing.definition: n. Act of gazing about; sightseeing.
gapesing.translation: n. [用作单数]；【兽病理学】(家禽、鸟类的)张口病, 开嘴症[参见 gapeworm]

gapeworm.definition:
n. The parasitic worm that causes the gapes in birds. See
   Illustration in Appendix.
gapeworm.translation:
n. 张口病线虫
[医] 张口病线虫, 气管比翼线虫

gaping.definition:
v look with amazement; look stupidly
v be wide open
v make an opening or gap in
s with the mouth wide open as in wonder or awe

gaposis.translation: 因衣服太紧纽扣间出现的裂口

gapp.translation: abbr. growth and profit plan 增长和盈利计划; growth and profit planning 增长和盈利计划

gapped.definition: v make an opening or gap in
gapped.translation: a. 豁裂的, 有缺口的

gapping.definition: v make an opening or gap in

gappy.translation: a. 有裂口的, 脱节的, 破裂的

gaps.definition:
n a conspicuous disparity or difference as between two figures
n an open or empty space in or between things
n a narrow opening
n a pass between mountain peaks
n a difference (especially an unfortunate difference) between two opinions or two views or two situations
n an act of delaying or interrupting the continuity
v make an opening or gap in
gaps.translation: n. 差异, 缺口；缝隙（gap的复数形式）
